_comment: Android target (e.g. an Android guest VM on an automotive SoC). See docs/MANUAL.md, 'Running on Android' — the DSP-side libc++.so.1 and libc++abi.so.1 must be staged into the SDK's lib/hexagon-<ver>/unsigned/ directory first, or every dialog fails with 'Failed to create device: 14001'.
_comment_platform: auto detects Android; set it explicitly only when the SDK is laid out for a different target than the one you are running on.
